ITEM 1 | Small round green heads with a bumpy, tightly layered surface, bright green with slightly darker bases, about 2.5–3 cm across each; five to six pieces clustered in the upper left of the plate, one with a pale cut base; firm, holds shape, dry surface with no visible oil or browning | 60

ITEM 2 | Dark purple-black oval fruits with glossy, slightly wrinkled skins, about 1.5–2 cm long, some whole and some with slight creases; roughly 25 pieces scattered in a cluster in the lower left center of the plate; moist-looking sheen, firm and whole, no visible sauce or oil pooling | 90

ITEM 3 | Pale green celery pieces cut into thin diagonal slices and short sticks, about 3–6 cm long and 0.5–1 cm wide, with fibrous stalk texture and a crisp-looking, moist surface; scattered in the upper right of the plate in a loose pile, some with a whiter cut edge; no dressing or cooking marks visible | 25
